comment: Model/mode templates (file bytes 2-3 and 20-31, in dump order) taken from real dumps. File bytes 20-29 and 31 are identical for all units of a model in the same configuration (two independent PE6000 units agree); file byte 30 only carries the checksum. X is the calibration weight and 'limit' the range limit, both in internal units of 1/8 display digit. See EEPROM_MAP.md.

templates.name: PE1600
templates.notes: Calibration weight 100000 digits (1000.00 g at 0.01 g readability); range limit 1600.90 g.

templates.name: PE3000-A
templates.source: own dump, scale whose EEPROM could no longer be reprogrammed
templates.notes: Calibration weight 10000 digits = 1 kg at 0.1 g readability. Differs from PE3000-B only in the calibration weight and the checksum byte.

templates.name: PE3000-B
templates.notes: French-market PE3000. Calibration weight 30000 digits = 3 kg at 0.1 g readability (the window is +-3.1 %, so the balance wants about 3 kg).

templates.name: PE6000
templates.source: own dump; independent forum PE6000 has the same bytes 20-29
templates.notes: Calibration weight 20000 digits = 2 kg at 0.1 g readability; range limit 6109.0 g. An independent forum dump has the same template.

templates.name: PE16
templates.notes: Calibration weight 40000 digits = 4 kg at 0.1 g readability (the service manual lists a 4 kg weight for the PE16); range limit 16009.0 g.

templates.name: PE360
templates.notes: Different family: file bytes 28-31 are not FF F8 .. 7F. Calibration weight 100000 digits (100.000 g at 0.001 g readability); range limit 360.090 g.

templates.name: PE3600
templates.notes: Different family, as PE360. Calibration weight 100000 digits (1000.00 g at 0.01 g readability); range limit 3600.90 g.
